column3: “Graves belong to me” is rendered “The grave is ready for me.”
“Their rebelling” is rendered “their provocation”; the meaning of the verse is uncertain.
“Make … stand surety” is rendered “Lay down … a pledge,” and “who will strike himself to my hand” as “who … will be my guarantor.”
The Hebrew is terse; NASB supplies “He who informs against” and “of the spoil.” The meaning is uncertain.
“A spitting to the face” is rendered “one at whom men spit”; the Hebrew may also mean “a byword.”
NASB supplies “saying,” and “from before” is rendered “in the presence of.” The meaning is uncertain.
“I have spread out my beds” is rendered “I make my bed.”
NASB supplies “If,” and “the maggot” as “the worm.”
“The poles of Sheol” is rendered “with me to Sheol”; the meaning of the Hebrew word is uncertain.
